notes.title: Spanish subtitles, bug fixes and weekly sale!
notes.notes:
Hi guys, as promised earlier this year we just published an update which adds the Spanish localization and fixes some occasional game breaking bugs reported by users (thanks!). To celebrate, Act I and Act II are featured in the weekly sale!

For all details and the changelog, please click here!
http://steamcommunity.com/app/378630/discussions/0/490125103634854139/

Thanks for your support!
